description_en: Retrieves log information for a managed instance
kebab_example: aliyun cddc list-prins-sql-error-log --instance-name pr-22a21ac289e00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPrinsSQLErrorLog

parameters.help_en: The name of the self-managed instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The Region ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The starting line number for log retrieval. A value of 0 indicates retrieving the latest log content. Default: 0
parameters.help_zh: 指定内容获取的开始行号，为0时表示获取最新的日志内容，默认值0
parameters.name: start_linenum

parameters.help_en: The number of log entries to query. Default: 30
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the query direction. Default value: false.

true: Queries in reverse order, retrieving Size log entries before StartLinenum. This returns data from the range (StartLinenum - Size, StartLinenum).
false: Queries in forward order, retrieving Size log entries after StartLinenum. This returns data from the range (StartLinenum, StartLinenum + Size)
parameters.help_zh:
是否正序查询，默认为false。

true: 表示从 StartLinenum 开始向上获取 Size 条日志内容，即返回 (StartLinenum - Size, StartLinenum) 区间内的数据。
false: 表示从 StartLinenum 开始向下获取 Size 条日志内容，即返回 (StartLinenum, StartLinenum+Size) 区间内的数据
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: The path of the log file. If left empty, the system automatically retrieves the path of the MySQL error log
parameters.help_zh: 日志所在路径，为空时会自动获取 mysql 错误日志位置
parameters.name: log_path

Content.description_en: The content of the log entry

Linenum.description_en: The line number of the log entry

LogPath.description_en: The path of the log file from which the entries were collected
LogPath.description_zh: 日志路径，指定要收集的日志所在路径

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of log entries found
